descriptor.publication_note: Saves definitions for the next catalogue and fresh construction. descriptor.publication_note: Membership edits affect new world plans. Existing saved plans retain their captured selection, base weights, IDs, roles and transforms; generated scene caches retain physical state. Same-ID consumed building/pool/item edits still face the separate pending-surface dependency gate. Save and byte-check reopen before sampling; parked drafts are excluded.

Already generated scenes use their saved map/population and stored entry metadata; Workbench does not regenerate or migrate them. A new layout ID joins no world selector automatically.

Changes load at the next game launch/catalogue initialization. Saved actors retain stored name, HP, armour, sight/hearing/darkvision, faction, hostility (including []) and wander radius. Description, attack, speed and pursuit use the current definition. Composite v1 saved actors retain their effective behavioural profile (including pursuit_timeout) and tactical commitment; profile edits affect fresh actors. HP edits do not rescale injured saves. New actors receive current constructor values; variants require explicit placement.
